prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a one-size-fits-all “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on what kind of ad you need (spokesperson vs. animated vs. repurposed content), your budget, scale, and the platforms you’re targeting. Below are top choices by use case and what they’re best at.

Top picks (by use case)

- Synthesia
  - Best for: AI spokesperson/host videos (realistic avatars, many languages)
  - Strengths: High-quality avatar lip-sync, brand kit, enterprise features, easy script → video workflow
  - Use if: You want a talking head presenter without actors

- HeyGen / Movio (similar alternatives)
  - Best for: Cheaper/faster AI presenters and multilingual ads
  - Strengths: Fast turnaround, realistic voices and avatars, good template library
  - Use if: You want presenter-style ads but need lower cost or faster testing

- InVideo / Canva Video
  - Best for: Template-based social ads (stories, reels, feed)
  - Strengths: Large template library, easy editing, presets for platform aspect ratios
  - Use if: You need quick social-first ads with customizable templates

- Pictory / Lumen5
  - Best for: Converting blog posts/scripts to video and repurposing long-form content
  - Strengths: Good for content marketing, automated captioning and scene generation
  - Use if: You’re turning written/long-form content into short ads

- Shakr / VidMob
  - Best for: Performance-driven ad scale and dynamic creative optimization
  - Strengths: Designed for ad platforms, dynamic templates, analytics integration, creative testing
  - Use if: You’re running many variations at scale and need data-driven optimization

- Descript
  - Best for: Precise editing, overdubs, and repurposing creator content
  - Strengths: Transcription-first editing, overdub voices, multitrack editing, filler-word removal
  - Use if: You have recorded footage or podcasts and want to make polished ads

- Runway
  - Best for: Creative/experimental visuals and advanced generative effects
  - Strengths: Cutting-edge generative tools, background replacement, creative effects
  - Use if: You need unique visuals that stand out

How to pick the right one
- Ad style: presenter vs animated vs UGC-style
- Platforms & sizes: TikTok/IG Reels vs Facebook feed vs YouTube (aspect ratios, lengths)
- Scale: single ad vs hundreds of dynamic variations
- Customization & brand controls (fonts, colors, logos)
- Voiceover & languages support
- Collaboration, API, analytics, and A/B testing features
- Budget & licensing for commercial ad use

If you tell me: your ad style (spokesperson, animated, UGC, product demo), target platforms, budget, and whether you need to produce many variations, I’ll recommend the best 2–3 specific tools and a quick workflow to get started.
